free_tier.stated: When you upload media to the Macaulay Library, the archive serves as your personal cloud storage and backup of your media files.

per_object_cap.stated: Upload full-resolution images, as long as they are JPG and under 20 MB each.

egress.terms: media are not available for personal download unless they belong to you.

record.interface_detail: eBird checklist upload (web + Manage Media page); Macaulay Library catalog pages; no documented public write API
record.tooling: no CLI. The uploader is a browser tool. Media search has an API but it sits behind an Anubis proof-of-work wall.
record.chaining: Not chainable programmatically. The write path is a UI and the read path returns re-encoded previews, not originals, to anyone but the owner.
record.limits_note: photo 20 MB/file (JPG); audio 500 MB/file (WAV); video 1 GB/file (MP4/MOV/M4V, ≥720p); 20 photos + 10 audio per species per checklist; 10 video files per species

identity_cost.detail: If the Add Media / Manage Media button doesn’t appear, make sure you are logged into your eBird account.

record.reliability_note: Classic rule-2 pattern: upload-open, read-gated. Your own originals come back, but nobody else's do, and the media endpoints are behind Anubis PoW (search.macaulaylibrary.org/api/v1/search returned the 'Making sure you're not a bot!' interstitial).
